title: Sjeltzer?
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: N is an integer.; 1 \leq N \leq 3 \times 10^5; S_i is a string consisting of digits (0-9).; |S_i| = 6; S_1, \dots, S_N are distinct.; V_i is an integer.; 1 \leq V_i \leq 10^9; Q is an integer.; 1 \leq Q \leq 3 \times 10^5; In each query, x and y are strings consisting of digits (0-9).; In each query, |x| = |y| = 6.
